title: Port prefix-authorization gate to C DAO processing
description: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_process.c process_dao() checks channel authentication, RPL instance/DODAG scope, and sequence freshness, but has NO per-origin prefix authorization: any authenticated sender can advertise any target (no self-/128 binding, no delegation table, no /0 denial). The Rust reference implementation now has this gate (DaoManager::authorize_dao_prefixes + PrefixDelegations in rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs, spec/05-routing.md section 8.7.1-8.7.2). Port the gate to rpl_dao_process.c with literal allow/deny parity tests (self /128 allowed, delegated allowed, foreign denied, /0 denied, no state mutation on denial). Delegation bootstrap/persistence is a separate concern per the Rust design.
